programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger visits Hot Springs, Arkansas for the annual RUNNING OF THE TUBS – to watch costumed teams race bathtubs filled with water through the downtown; stops in for an historic scrub down & steam at the BUCKSTAFF BATH HOUSE; takes in an astounding collection of 3D advertising art at the POLLACK MUSEUM in AZ; and then attempts to pick the right square at CHICKEN POOP BINGO in Austin, TX.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger drives the Illinois leg of historic ROUTE 66 to find: the birthplace of the COZY DOG in Springfield; a city hall with a phone booth on its roof in LINCOLN; the land-yacht of itinerant Route 66 artist Bob Waldmire in PONTIAC; a roadside attraction called HENRY’S RABBIT RANCH; and then rides along at the annual bike race/eating contest known as the TOUR DE DONUT in Staunton.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: In Chicago, host Will Clinger attends the parody of the IDITAROD - the CHI-DITAROD, where the sled is a shopping cart pulled by people instead of dogs; checks in to the Watergate Hotel’s SCANDAL ROOM in DC; visits the studio of surrealist MICHAEL P PRICE in Arizona; squeezes himself into a DWARF CAR for a drive in Maricopa; and then marvels at an art exhibit made entirely out of PEEPS in Wisconsin.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger visits McMinnville, Oregon’s UFO FEST to witness the extraterrestrial parade & alien pet contest; examines the MUSEUM OF MENTAL HEALTH in Salem where One Flew Over The Cuckoo’s Nest was filmed; tries not to crash in a jet simulator at the NAVAL FLIGHT ACADEMY in Pensacola; and then marvels at the huge model ships and animated “rock band” made completely out of…TOOTHPICKS!

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger journeys hundreds of feet underground to tour the historic QUEEN COPPER MINE in beautiful Bisbee, Arizona; spends the night at the nearby SHADY DELL retro trailer park; goes nowhere but up at an WHITE MOUNTAIN HOT AIR BALLOONFEST and then tries to dodge ferocious flying carp at the annual central Illinois REDNECK FISHING TOURNAMENT (spoiler alert: he fails).

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger delves into the paranormal legends surrounding EDGAR ALLAN POE and the USS CONSTELLATION in Baltimore; reaches for his wallet at America’s only PURSE MUSEUM in Little Rock; wanders among hundreds of critters at the MIDWEST FUR FEST in Chicago; and then tees off with Sister Cindy at an event called (no kidding) BEAT THE NUN.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger feels right at home in a roomful of dummies at the VENTRILOQUISTS’ CONVENTION in Kentucky; finds all things feline at the LUCKY CAT MUSEUM in Cincinnat; drives out to CARHENGE - Nebraska’s answer to Stonehenge; and then sees where the bodies are not buried but frozen (in liquid nitrogen) at ALCOR CRYOGENICS in Scottsdale – Open To The Public!

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger spends an entire episode chronicling the annual, KINETIC SCULPTURE RACE in Baltimore – an outrageously challenging competition among two dozen human-powered, amphibious, all-terrain mobile works of art slogging through a 15 mile course of city streets, mud, sand and Baltimore’s inner harbor. All entries are vying for the coveted GRAND MEDIOCRE CHAMPION award.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger attends the traveling ODDITIES and CURIOSITIES EXPO and encounters some truly bizarre and disturbing exhibits; samples the entertainment and menu at America's only VEGAN STRIP CLUB in Portland; takes in some target practice at MACHINE GUN AMERICA near Orlando; then ascends the UFO WATCHTOWER in Colorado to search the night sky for extraterrestrials.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo busca consejo en Manuela tras la muerte de Celia. Ella le sugiere mudarse con sus hijos, mientras Jade insulta a Benjamín tratándolo como Néstor Cordido. En el cementerio, Elizabeth y Moisés sufren por la pérdida. María del Pilar anuncia su embarazo a René y Gustavo, generando dudas sobre la paternidad de Marcelo. Finalmente, Hortensia y Benjamín planean viajar con Glorita, y Cecilia regresa al hato para organizar el futuro de sus sobrinos tras hallar sobres escritos por Celia.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín intenta huir del país con Hortensia y Glorita, pero es arrestado en el aeropuerto por las autoridades y Ricardo. Katiuska queda al frente del emporio Tarifa. Romina persuade a María del Pilar de fingir su embarazo para casarse con Marcelo. Amparo defiende la inocencia de Benjamín, mientras Ricardo recrimina a Manuela por no avisarle sobre Glorita. La tensión aumenta tras la captura de Benjamín, quien niega su verdadera identidad ante la policía.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Sofía continúa haciendo todo lo posible por lograr que Agustín y Magdalena se divorcien, ya que lo quiere solamente para ella. Esta vez, lo emborracha y lo convence de pasar la noche juntos. Agustín no vuelve a su casa hasta el otro día, cuando pone la excusa de que ha tenido que dormir solo en un hotel. Gabriel empieza a darse cuenta de la gravedad de su enfermedad y se emociona hablando con Gloria de los viejos tiempos en que los dos junto con Epicúreo eran inseparables. Está dispuesto a hacer todo con tal de no morirse a causa de su problema en los riñones. Maikel está cansado de la mentira de su tío a Valentina, está cansado de que lo vean como una persona que no es. Es por eso que, aparentemente, puede llegar a decir toda la verdad que Epicúreo tiene tan bien guardada.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Julieta habla con la secretaria del Doctor y esta le confirma que su mamá hace más de veinte años que se atiende ahí y nunca estuvo embarazada. Julieta muy confundida y angustiada va a ver a Valentina, la cual se queda muy mal por la noticia y la deja sola un momento. Es ahí cuando Efraín llama a la oficina de Valentina y atiende su hija, al reconocer la voz Efraín se asusta y corta la llamada, al mismo tiempo Julieta también reconoció la voz y cada vez entiende menos. Magdalena habla con Agustín y le dice que lo mejor es que tomen distancia por un tiempo. Entonces Agustín en contra de lo dicho habla con Rodrigo para que convenza a su madre de que su padre se quede, que no quiere que se vaya.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Julieta le dice a Ana que en el hospital le dijeron que Ana nunca había estado embarazada pero Ana le miente y le dice que seguro fue un error y Julieta se calma. Efraín besa a Valentina y esta le dice que se vaya de su casa pero luego se queda pensando en todos los sentimientos que le ocasionaron ese beso y se lo cuenta a Epicúreo que se pone muy celoso y trata de minimizarlo. Maikel presiona a Epicúreo para que le diga le verdad a Valentina sobre que ambos no son gay ni son pareja. Julieta le pregunta a Efraín por qué no la reconoció cuando había llamado por teléfono y este se hace el distraído y le dice que seguramente debió ser una equivocación, que él no había llamado a Valentina y Julieta le cree y se va a la facultad.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel le dice a Magdalena que con ella es diferente que se está enamorando pero ella no le cree nada y piensa que con todas es igual. Valentina le cuenta a Epicúreo toda la historia de su hija y le confirma que es Julieta Fernández, la hija de Efraín y Ana Belén. Ana habla por celular con Julieta y le dice que hubo un error, que ella no hablo con el doctor Salas, que es su mamá pero Julieta no confía plenamente y luego cuando llega a la casa encuentra unas fotos raras y se dedica a averiguar que es lo que pasa. Ricardo acuerda con Julieta que publicará en “La Deslenguada” que lo de Magdalena y Gabriel fueron rumores infundados pero con una condición, que vaya a la casa con Jamer y le averigüe todo sobre Magdalena Miranda.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Julieta se entera que no es hija de Ana Belén, por unos registros del hospital donde nació. Efraín y Ana Belén tratan de calmarla, pero no lo logran. Julieta se decide a irse de la casa, y Seis nueve le ofrece quedarse con Dilenis. Al día siguiente, Julieta se encuentra con Patricia, una monja que había ido a hacer un informe a ese barrio, y dos muchachos aparecen para acosarlas. Efraín habla con Valentina, para contarle lo sucedido, y ella le asegura que no fue quien le confesó eso a Julieta, cuando justo llega Ana Belén para hablar con Valentina. Nayarí decide contarle a Deibis que su tío es Gabriel León, pero a Deibis sólo le cae mal la noticia, ya que se había cruzado una vez con él, y no lo trató bien.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cristóbal confirma sus sospechas con respecto a Ana y a su primo, sabe que ambos le están mintiendo pero no va a decir nada porque no quiere perder a su novia antes de casarse. Escucha los consejos de Pedro de que mantenga la calma y no la cele porque lo único que va a lograr es que Ana lo deje. Ana siente que cuando más conoce a Guillermo más se da cuenta que es el hombre de su vida. Mientras tanto Nancy explota cuando llegan a su apartamento Lázara y Pedro con la intención de hablar con Carlos de las cuentas del condominio, todo armado por el Fantasma que crea cizaña con todos. Nancy se va del apartamento enojada a buscar a un vecino que si admira su belleza y la piropea.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Luego de la reunión del condominio y que en el mismo se decidiera que Lázara fuera la presidenta, ésta se apresura a llamar a su comadre Pura para darle la buena noticia de que iban a ser junto a su esposo Jesús, los conserjes del edificio. Lo que no cayó muy bien a Pura fue saber que Lázara pasará a ser su jefa. Mientras tanto esto ocurre, Pedrote va a tener a sus dos amores, en el mismo edificio. Por un lado, Purita quien hace tiempo que está detrás de ella, y por el otro Patricia, que representa lo nuevo y prohibido. Luisito sigue soñando con su reina, y pero se da cuenta que es prácticamente imposible.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cristóbal le cuenta a “Onofre” lo que tiene pensado hacer, de ir a pegarle a Guillermo. Pero “Onofre” lo detiene a que piense mejor las cosas, y le ofrece una idea que casi con certeza hará que funcione. Aconseja a Cristóbal guardarse su dignidad y su ego, con el fin de sacar provecho y sentirse triunfador ante su primo Guillermo. Cristóbal toma el consejo de “Onofre” y se dirige hacia la casa de Ana. Mientras Ana llega al colegio desbastada por el episodio que tuvo con Cristóbal, se encuentra en la entrada del colegio con Marilda. Dónde ésta le pregunta el porqué de su llanto. Ana le cuenta que ya no hay boda con Cristóbal.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Luego de que Cristóbal se enterara la verdad acerca de que su Ana era la misma Ana de la historia de amor de Guillermo, rompe su relación con ella, por lo que Marilda y Guillermo encuentran la oportunidad de volver con sus respectivos amores. Pero Onofre le aconseja a Cristóbal que no se separe, y vuelve al ruedo cuando le perdona a Ana la mentira, y le pide nuevamente que se case con él. Mientras que Venancio continúa en la búsqueda del asesino por el envenenado del acotamiento, otra muerte sucumbe al condominio: Diego, el vecino del cuarto piso, apareció sin vida en su apartamento por presunta muerte natural.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: La muerte imprevista de Diego sembró un dolor durísimo en Daniela, pero también dejó a la luz que las sospechas de su deceso recayeran sobre Pedro, quien continúa moviendo las fichas en las vidas de todos los vecinos del condominio. Tanto es así, que luego de que la autopsia determinara “muerte natural”, intenta convencer a Daniela para que no venda el apartamento. Ella no podrá afrontar el costo mensual por el crédito bancario que con su marido habían sacado para comprarlo, y Pedro le ofrece un préstamo. Con esto, y ante la inminente seguridad de que tampoco podrá pagárselo, querrá quedarse con el apartamento.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker y Yubiri se besan como les exigen en la película pero ellos se besan de verdad y cuando dicen corten | ellos siguen besándose. Intervienen entonces Briggite y Juan Diego. Lolita trata de convencer a Solymar que lo que es del cura va para la iglesia. Freddy se burla de Yubiri por lo del beso. Briggite llega y también le dice que terminó siendo una gran actriz Carolina y Juan Diego tienen una gran discusión. Ella le reclama que haya dicho corte por el megáfono.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Ana y Pastor tuvieron relaciones Olegario le cuenta a Carlitos un cuento de él y de Ana diciéndole que es el cuento de una princesa y el dragón. Briggite le cuenta a Finita que Ana se empató con Pastor y Briggite también se lo cuenta a Armando. Ana está pensando en lo que está haciendo empatándose con Pastor | teniendo relaciones con Olegario y pronta a casarse con Mauricio. Suena la puerta y es Mauricio que le dice que tienen que hablar de su boda. Mauricio deja que Ana hable ROKUro.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Finita le cuenta a Botero que hace 10 años que tiene un amante. A un hombre que quiere y que quiere divorciarse de el. Que lo odia. Botero no cree ni una palabra de lo que le está diciendo. Briggite le comenta a Dionisia | Carolina y Lolita que Armando le ofreció matrimonio. Finita hace dos maletas una de Botero y otra de ella. Botero tiene que decir quien se va | el o ella. Finita y Fabián terminan la pelea yéndose Fabián de la casa para no regresar jamás. Un poco de mujeres caminando.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker y Yubiri tienen su día de amor. Juan Diego está en la casa de Bienvenida buscando a Yubiri. Bienvenida se preocupa porque ella pensaba que estaba en la agencia. Pero entonces todos piensan que está con Solymar pero esta llega en ese preciso momento buscándola. Fabián | Junior | Olegario y Pastor están jugando dominó. Fabián vuelve con lo de Finita y de repente todos se le quedan viendo porque tiene dos tremendos cachos. Finita le cuenta a Ana lo de Armando.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Todo el mundo comienza a preguntar y Freddy es el que le dice a todos que esa pareja está empatada. Briggite está que se muere y comienza a preguntar que como es eso de que Yubileisy está empatada con su Whisky. Bienvenida sigue diciéndoles cosas a Yubiri y a Wilker. Ellos están pensando en ellos y Briggite totalmente fuera de lugar. Freddy y Solymar están afuera de la casa de Bienvenida hablando de lo mismo. Freddy le dice que es su héroe. Todos se van y se queda Yubiri con Briggite.

programme.desc: Milagros y Enzo están en el ascensor y mientras ella cuenta para que él lo haga andar él le quita los documentos de la cartera para que ella tenga que volver a verlo. programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Clemencia le dice a la madre Pilar que quiere ver a Milagros al día siguiente en su oficina, ya que piensa que Milagros le dio a Enzo el golpe que se merecía; pero no sólo eso, sino que siente que le debe a Milagros que salvara a su hija Gina de un secuestro. programme.title: mareTV: Peru - Coast of the Incas
programme.desc: Dramatically, the coast plunges into the sea, the so-called Costa of Peru is a gigantic desert on the Pacific Ocean, 2,400 kilometers long. Rugged, bizarre, like from another star. Ancient cultures settled here, the Moche and the Chimú. Later the proud Inca, the self-proclaimed royal people of the Andes, ruled. In the small town of Huanchaco in northern Peru, the fishermen build a new boat every month: from reed. The small ships are called Caballito de Totora (reed horses), because the shape is reminiscent of a horse and the fishermen ride in it kneeling in the waves. About 2,000 years ago, the moche used it to go out to sea. Carlos Segura Azola is a descendant of the moche. He is currently building a "reed horse" again. But actually something completely different occupies him. Carlos has been afraid of the sea ever since his father drowned at work. The fisherman consults a Brucha, a witch. She tries to drive him out of panic at the Pacific with mysterious ceremonies. At some point Carlos' reed boat is finished and he has to get out to his nets again. In the south, in the port city of Pisco, there are hardly any private cars. Mototaxis on three wheels are the means of transport here. Every moto looks different, because the young drivers compete with each other. They constantly pimp out their tricycles with spoilers, mirrors and all kinds of decorations. Because if you stand out in the traffic jam, you get the most passengers. But nowhere else in Peru is road traffic as dense and chaotic as in the capital Lima. That's why Juan Ortiz goes daily with his Delta glider over the coastal road into the air. He is the flying reporter and reports live for the traffic news. And he is not alone with his aircraft. Dozens of paragliders float along the cliffs of Lima at any time of the day. The Pacific provides a constant upwind on the up to 160 meter high cliffs. Somewhere in the labyrinth of the metropolis of millions hundreds of believers trot to the beat of the music of a Jesus statue on the cross. A procession for the "Lord of Miracles", the brass band intones church songs. The music student Bruno Alvarado drags and plays the largest instrument, a sousaphone. Every day there are dozens of processions in Lima. Practical for Bruno, he finances his studies with the musical accompaniment. Away from the hustle and bustle of the big city, in the Paracas National Park, it is deserted. Luis Zapato runs a kiosk on a lonely beach amidst huge sand dunes. The kiosk has meanwhile developed into a gourmet temple, even the capital city dwellers flock here. Especially because of the scallops that Luis is the only licence holder to collect far and wide from the seabed. Inti Mar he called his beach snack, Inti is the sun god, Mar the sea. At Luis you literally eat like a sun god at the sea. This is only possible here, on the Inca coast.

programme.title: mareTV: Mexico's Caribbean Coast
programme.desc: The palm tree laden beaches on Mexico's Riviera Maya on the Yucatan peninsula are endless, and the turquoise sea with its gentle Caribbean surf is a warm 25 degrees during the mild winter in this part of the world. Between Cancún and Punta Allen, where once there was little more than bushland and a few sleepy fishing villages, vibrant life has evolved during the past three decades. Richard Sowa has lived on a floating island for the past 15 years: an island he built himself out of empty plastic bottles. The bon vivant him-self sees it as a "solution for our planet's refuse problem". Off Punta Allen, a village in the bay of Sian Ka'an, Mexican Mara Coral Ley and her cousin Kim, continue to catch lobsters by adhering to the traditional method and were awarded an "Eco seal for sustainable fishing" for their trouble. It is silent under water off Isla Mujeres and it is here that the artist Jason deCaires has constructed a sculpture park. Hundreds of lifesize figures form an artificial reef at a depth of 12 metres. Fish and plants complete his work of art. The master himself is convinced: "Mother Nature is the true artist".

programme.title: glCuba - Brilliantly Caribbean
programme.desc: Even anyone who has not yet been to Cuba can conjure up certain images of American vintage street cruisers, imposing buildings that have seen better days, white sandy beaches full of palms and loving couples on the Malecón against a backdrop of crashing waves. This island is somewhat of a myth and its people generate a special joie de vivre. The legendary Hershey Train departs for Matanzas from the capital, Havana. On the oldest electrified railway line in the Caribbean, 60-year-old Spanish carriages make their way along al-most 100 kilometres of coastline in the most relaxed way possible. The Salvavidas on Varadero, probably the most famous beach on the island, have a particular-ly beautiful workplace. The lifeguards' territory ex-tends for more than 20 kilometres. In order to protect the coasts of Cuba, mangroves have been replanted here for many years. The project is supported by the UN and planting is often carried out by schoolchildren. In doing so, Cuban children learn how to treat their maritime habitat in a sustainable fashion. The former colonial city of Trinidad on Cuba's south coast is gen-erally considered to be one of the most beautiful places in the entire Caribbean. The houses here are particular-ly colourful. A plethora of magnificent buildings can be seen at the Plaza Mayor, the neo-baroque main square.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Lahemaa National Park on Estonias Baltic coast features ancient forests, rivers and peninsulas where nature has remained largely untouched.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: The Curonian Spit is a narrow peninsula of dunes and forests shaped by destruction and recovery through careful human intervention.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: We travel from Georgia through the Carolinas to Virginia, ending near Washington, DC. Along the way we meet a Georgia farmer; talk to painter J. Chris Wilson in Charleston; sail along the Outer Banks of Carolina, and visit rural Virginia, experiencing life in the beautiful southern states.

programme.title: mareTV: The Eckernförde Bay - Beach shooters, mine clearance divers, squirrels
programme.desc: Fjord, ford, bay, gulf: there are many names for the beautiful extensions of the Baltic Sea into the country. Eckernförde Bay is shaped by currents, surf and people. It stretches 17 kilometers to the town that gives it its name. Stephan Möller is the acting shooting master of the Eckernförder Bürgerschützengilde. He spent a whole year preparing the beach shooting festival and then this: fog, rain and a stiff breeze. Traditionally, the Eckernförde marksmen always shoot at a wooden bird in the direction of the sea at Whitsun. Under strict conditions! And these stipulate a clear view of at least one kilometer out into the bay. The event literally threatens to fall through, for the first time in 449 years. Around 3,000 soldiers are stationed at the Eckernförde naval base, but only a small group is allowed to call itself an elite unit: the mine divers. They are considered the toughest soldiers in the Navy. Anyone who wants to be one of them has to undergo extreme training. This year, just two candidates made it to the final round. Now they still have to pass the dreaded final exam: running 20 kilometers with marching gear and then swimming ten kilometers through Eckernförde Bay.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The Parque Nacional Peneda-Gerês is the only national park in Portugal. An area of almost 700 square kilometers, located in the extreme north of Portugal. Barren and rocky ridges in the plateaus, contrast with large forests and lush ground vegetation in deep valleys, crossed by lakes and rivers. The park is known for its oak forests, which are predominantly pedunculate and Pyrenean oaks. Among the typical animals of the park are the small Garrano ponies, a very old breed of horse and the only one in Europe that still lives in the wild.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: In the southwest of Portugal lies the little known Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina. It encompasses a narrow coastal strip that runs along the coast to the south of Portugal. Sparsely populated, this coastal region, which was placed under protection in 1988, is considered one of the last intact ecosystems in Europe. The steep cliffs, the almost constant wind and high waves have ensured that mass tourism has not gained a foothold here. There are still near-natural forests and a diverse bird life.

programme.title: mareTV: In Alaska's Fjord World
programme.desc: Gigantic fjords and over 5,000 small islands: In Alaska's south there's a lot of wilderness and little civilization. The region between the capital Juneau and the Canadian border is also known by locals as the "Last Frontier", the last outpost. Michelle Masden, for example, has come to terms with the harsh conditions here. She is the only seaplane pilot in the region. She earns her living with her 65-year-old Beaver: as an air taxi, transport plane and now and then as a rescuer in last necessity. Michelle flies anything and everything: spare parts and food, doctors, hikers and hunters. For the fishermen of southern Alaska she searches for large shoals of fish and guides the captains to the next good catch. Ray Rusaw was a car mechanic by profession, but in his old age he was gripped by gold fever. With a self-built special raft and a highly creative selection of equipment from the DIY store, he sets off in search of the precious metal that his predecessors overlooked two centuries ago. For four years he has been happily obsessively combing through sandbanks and river courses. For Ray, the search for gold has little to do with luck and much to do with meticulous research. He is certain that he has found the perfect spot.

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland - Winter in the Swiss Alps
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It’s a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It’s a country that’s astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Tanzania is known for its national parks, vast landscapes and wild roads. They make traveling a real adventure. We travel in trucks, buses and off-road vehicles from the Indian Ocean via the Serengeti to Lake Victoria, accompany huge herds of wildebeest, observe lions and rhinos - and show the lives of the people who live on and along the roads.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Far out in the "Wild West" of Canada lies Bella Coola. If you want to get to the small town on the Pacific, you have no choice: there is only one road leading there, the Bella Coola Highway. It is constantly monitored and yet remains dangerous. Gravel roads, narrow hairpin bends and steep mountain slopes make the highway in British Columbia a particular challenge.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the far north-east of Georgia, on the border with Russia, the Abano Pass leads to lofty heights. At almost 3000 metres it is the highest passable road in the Great Caucasus. It winds its way up dizzyingly steep slopes. On wild paths, it leads through a fascinating landscape.

programme.title: The Green Heart of Croatia - At the Banks of River Sava
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Wild River Rhine
programme.desc: Alluvial forests, roaring waterfalls, steep canyons and sunny slopes flank the river Rhine. The variety of habitats is the reason for the large biodiversity along the stream.There is hardly any other river in Germany that is surrounded by as many myths and legends as the river Rhine. No other river has been the topic of songs, has been painted and travelled equally frequently. Despite this it still seems to be true today what the French poet Victor Hugo once said about this river – the Rhine is a river everybody talks about, nobody explores, everybody visits but no one really knows. The film follows the water against the stream. It starts at the river’s delta in the Netherlands, flows through six countries and ends in the Swiss Alps.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Butterflies surely are the most fancied species inside the insect world. Their beautiful colouring and their graceful flight appeal to everyone. There are close to 4000 types of Butterflies – today many of them are endangered due to the loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: The most spectacular change of seasons - Spring
programme.desc: This film explores Central Europe and presents the nature from a perspective you have never seen before. Fascinating landscape footage in high-quality HD technology, coupled with spectacular Cineflex aerial views, take us on a journey through the hitherto unknown blazes of colour of the Central European region and its inhabitants. We show you paradise on earth and demonstrate how climate and astronomy determine our life cycle. While seasons change, we visit several different European habitats that - in their diversity, are exemplary of a Central European region. Mountains, water, forests and meadows: we return to each of these habitats at different times of the year and show how the rhythm of life of each of our protagonists follows nature's clock. The four seasons determine all of the coming and passing away; a highly complex interplay in the universe of life. We explore the wondrous worlds of the mysterious cycle of nature together with extraordinary people. Breathtaking landscapes enable us to experience the change of seasons at first hand.

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: ¡Regina afirma que Fernando es el padre de su hijo, pero su madre lo niega! Su familia lo apoya, aunque él fue asesinado. Mientras tanto, Krystal y Ben discuten su relación y quién es el padre de la hija de Krystal.

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: Tras una noche de pasión con su vecino, Lashanda afirma que Avery es el padre, ¡pero su novia no lo acepta! Además, Nikki necesita demostrar que nunca le ha sido infiel a Daniel o su relación con toda su familia estará en peligro.

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Brandon pasó un tiempo en la cárcel tras ser acusado de abusar sexualmente de su sobrina. Mantiene su inocencia y afirma que no es la primera vez que su sobrina acusa a alguien de abuso. ¿Fue instruida por Billy, el novio de su hermana?

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Un niño pequeño sufrió lesiones graves que pusieron en peligro su vida, pero no solo su madre, Jessica, es considerada sospechosa, sino que su novio, Major, y su abuela, Crystal, también están siendo investigados. ¡Descubre la impactante verdad hoy!

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Desmond cree que su ex, Cassandra, está inventando todo un cuento de que él ha tocado a su hijo porque está celosa de su nueva prometida. Después, Tammy ha sido investigada por abuso infantil e incluso acusada de encerrar a sus hijos en un armario.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Joanne quiere tener un trío con su amiga y el novio de su amiga; la novia de Ron está increíblemente celosa por una razón; Jazmen confronta a su novio y a una mujer con la que ha estado enviando mensajes de texto sexuales.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: La hermana de Megan sabe algo que podría hacerle cambiar de opinión sobre su novio infiel; la Princesa admite tener sentimientos por su ex; la novia de Brad se pregunta por qué ha cambiado su actitud hacia ella.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Las strippers Precious y Jewels tienen demasiado en común; John descubre que su amigo es responsable de la crisis de su matrimonio; la novia de DJ quiere ver a otras personas.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Chloe y Dan se casarán pronto, pero finalmente está lista para contarle a él en qué trabaja de verdad. Entonces la madre de Amanda le ruega que renuncie a su trabajo.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: James está comprometido con Amanda, pero ahora confiesa lo de Melanie. Después, Jewel compite por el amor de su amante cuando Christa anuncia que lo quiere para ella.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Una familia influyente enfrenta un giro trágico cuando María Mercedes Gnecco muere en circunstancias sospechosas. El esposo, inicialmente señalado como víctima, se convierte en el principal sospechoso de su asesinato tras varios descubrimientos.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Colombia, varios casos de muertes neonatales han revelado graves negligencias médicas. Las familias afectadas buscan justicia. La falta de leyes que protejan a las madres ha llevado a impulsar una legislación para prevenir la tragedia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Fernanda, Marleny y Jonathan son víctimas de préstamos digitales que se convierten en cobros intimidantes. Séptimo Día investiga Call Centers que usan tácticas de intimidación para cobrar deudas. Las autoridades y expertos advierten sobre los riesgos de estas aplicaciones.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En las sombras de las cárceles colombianas, las visitas conyugales se convierten en escenarios de horror. Reclusos peligrosos, aprovechando fallas en la seguridad, transforman momentos íntimos en tragedias.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Carolina, de 48 años y de nacionalidad venezolana, cuenta su experiencia en el modelaje webcam.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Ana Lucía quiere justicia luego de que su padre la dejara embarazada a los 14 años y nunca fue a la cárcel.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Ángela Carolina, una menor de edad, fue hallada muerta en una fosa común en Villa Rica, Tolima. John Fredy, de 31 años, confesó ser el autor intelectual del crimen, motivado por un odio hacia su esposa Yuli Marcela tras una infidelidad. Fue condenado a 36 años de prisión por homicidio agravado contra la menor y su esposa. Ahora, pretende cambiar su versión, pero las autoridades no le dan validez.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 23 de junio de 2014 en Chinchiná, Alfair Sabogal atacó brutalmente a seis miembros de una familia por celos e intentó matar a su pareja, Diana Marín, quien quedó con secuelas visuales.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En La Montañita, Caquetá, Jhon Jairo Marín rehace su vida con Yineth Mosquera, quien, celosa del hijo de su pareja, Esneider, termina atentando contra la vida del menor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2012, en Cúcuta, Johana Rincón fue hallada muerta en su casa con señales de tortura. Aunque su esposo fue el primer sospechoso, la investigación reveló que el verdadero culpable era su sobrino, quien la asesinó para robar los ahorros de su tío. Tras huir a Venezuela y esconderse durante varios días, fue capturado por la Policía al regresar a Colombia.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: La familia Peña, famosa por su negocio de papas y altruismo, enfrentó extorsión y amenazas. Milciades intentó proteger a Rubiela y su hija, pero la situación trágicamente terminó en un triple asesinato.

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2008, Nidia Yazmín González, madre soltera de 37 años, fue hallada muerta en el río Gámeza, Boyacá, con signos de brutal violencia. Mantenía una relación secreta con Alirio Castro, un hombre casado, posesivo y celoso. Pruebas clave —su cinturón negro en karate y un historial de maltrato— lo señalaron como responsable. Absuelto en 2009, la fiscalía apeló y en 2011 fue condenado a 33 años de prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The positive impact made by the shooting sports and recreational shooting to people across our country can’t be measured in just one story, so we have three. In Florida, Olympian Dania Vizzi trains at her home shooting facility and talk about how she went from ballerina to one of the best shotgun shooters in the world. In Nebraska, firearms instructor Thea Van Syoc has used the disciplines of competitive pistol shooting and training to help shape her life. Finally we’ll take a look into the National African American Gun Association and learn how one day at the range for Phillip Smith created the fastest growing firearm organization in the United States.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

Lastly, Slade introduces a property that we have already made a video on, but with just how amazing the land is, we had to include it! Floweree is the epitome of a sportsman's paradise!

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood for - strong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching into - classrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintaining - balance in the wild. They’re also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today’s culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it’s about continuing something that matters.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: The Principle
programme.desc: A wise master is called upon to heal a painfully misguided cyberbully and his tragic victim

programme.title: ALCOHOL - THE MAGIC POTION
programme.desc: Alcohol is the world’s most powerful drug. Four billion people drink it regularly and the number is rising. Of the world’s 30 countries with the highest per capita alcohol consumption, no fewer than 26 are in Europe. Big business with 3 million victims each year. But who profits from all this?

programme.title: SHARING THE HARVEST
programme.desc: SHARING THE HARVEST follows farmers who reject conventional agriculture's growth pressures. Filmmaker Philipp Petruch explores three solidarity farming initiatives aiming to build sustainable, community-supported food systems. Through community, courage, and a new consumer-producer relationship, they show how we can transform agriculture - and the world.

programme.title: The Highest Pass
programme.desc: Part heart-pounding adventure, part spiritual quest, THE HIGHEST PASS, a feature length documentary, premiered in Los Angeles to sold out audiences. The award-winning film shares the journey of seven seekers, including one who has never ridden a motorcycle, who follow a guru with a Vedic death prophecy on a moto journey up to the highest pass of the Indian Himalayas. Over 21 days and up to an elevation of 18,000 feet along a winding road, they never let low oxygen, altitude sickness, river-flooded roads, icy edges, snow and loaded trucks dampen their spirits or, ultimately, their deeper selves.

programme.title: The Keeper of the Keys
programme.desc: Michael Walden is having one bad day after another and there is no end in sight. After losing his job and finding his house in foreclosure, he becomes increasingly negative and frustrated. It doesn't help that his fiancee, Anne breaks off their engagement. Depressed and discouraged, he falls asleep. Success coach Jack Canfield appears and tells Michael he is sending some friends, experts who will help him to discover 7 Keys and how to use them. Join Michael and his mysterious guide Elizabeth as they encounter a diverse group of experts eager to enlighten him.

programme.title: The Secrets of the Keys
programme.desc: Elizabeth comes face-to-face with her spiritual guide, Gwen who has an intriguing opportunity for her.

programme.title: When Sparks Ignite
programme.desc: A film about the challenges we face that then become that match point that ignites something within us that becomes our gift to the world.

programme.title: Expiration Date
programme.desc: Charlie Silvercould III carries around a family curse passed down from his grandfather; death by a milk truck on his 25th birthday. With eight days left, Charlie accepts his fate and starts taking care of his unfinished business, until he meets a girl who won't let him die in peace.

programme.title: Piripkura
programme.desc: The last two surviving members of the Piripkura people, a nomadic tribe in the Mato Grasso region of Brazil, struggle to maintain their indigenous way of life amidst the region's massive deforestation.

programme.title: Boobs: The War On Women's Breast
programme.desc: The films investigates the controversy swirling around the breast cancer screening test mammography.

programme.title: Cancer: The Integrative Perspective
programme.desc: Cancer: The Integrative Perspective takes a deep dive into the fast-expanding paradigm of holistic and integrative wellness approaches for preventing and reversing cancer that treats the disease with conventional tools, while also supporting patients’ strength, stamina and quality of life with evidence-based natural therapies.

programme.title: Gas Hole
programme.desc: From claims of buried technology which drastically improves gas mileage, to bureaucratic governmental roadblocks, to consumers’ reluctance to embrace alternatives, GAS HOLE provides a detailed examination of America’s continued dependence on foreign oil and sheds light on the economic and sociological forces that have contributed to that dependence.

programme.title: Phosfate
programme.desc: Cancer survivor and filmmaker Erik E. Crown joins local water activists to investigate accelerated cancer rates and other illnesses in central Florida communities, tracing the source to phosphate mining and the pollution of the state's waterways by a multinational corporation.

programme.title: Land of Little Rivers
programme.desc: The Land of Little Rivers, a network of tributaries in the Catskill Mountains of New York, is the birthplace of fly fishing in America and home to anglers obsessed by the sport.

programme.desc: Check out Angry Birds Toons compilations! Each compilation has several episodes from your favorite shows including Angry Birds, Piggy Tales, and Stella!

Bino and Fino have many adventures where, with the help of their friend Zeena the Magic Butterfly, they discover and learn things about the world.

Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! programme.title: Anthony Green: So Long, Avalon Live In New York
programme.desc: Experience Anthony Green live from the Gramercy Theatre in New York as he celebrates the release of So Long, Avalon. An intimate, high–energy set blends new material with fan favorites, spontaneous crowd moments, and a playful nod to classic “Kokomo.” Green spotlights his touring band — Greg Mervine (drums), Sean Cohen (multi-instrumentalist), Dave Davison, and Keith Goodwin — and shouts out friends Kurt Travis and Geoff Rickly for helping shape a special night. A dynamic performance that captures Green’s voice, humor, and gratitude in a room full of true believers.

programme.title: New Order on Power, Corruption & Lies
programme.desc: Record On explores the making of New Order’s groundbreaking 1983 album Power, Corruption & Lies and its defining single “Blue Monday.” Featuring Bernard Sumner, Peter Hook, Stephen Morris, and Gillian Gilbert, the episode examines how the band evolved from the tragedy of Joy Division into pioneering electronic innovators inspired by New York’s club scene.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Drummer and producer Cody Hanson of Hinder joins Joel Madden to reflect on two decades of the band’s journey—from college shows in Oklahoma to multi-platinum success with “Lips of an Angel.” They discuss songwriting, evolving as musicians, and the making of their new single “Bring Me Back to Life.”

programme.title: Lamb of God: Killadelphia
programme.desc: Lamb of God's Killadelphia showcases the thrash-metal band at The Trocadero in 2005, featuring a recorded set, candid footage, and an all-access portrait.

programme.title: Queen: Live at the Rainbow '74
programme.desc: Queen performs a 1974 concert at London’s Rainbow Theatre, capturing the band’s early rise with a powerful live set.

programme.title: Los Lonely Boys: Live at the Fillmore
programme.desc: Live At The Fillmore finds Texican rock trio Los Lonely Boys blowing the roof off the legendary San Francisco venue with their hits "Heaven" and "More Than Love" plus covers of Richie Valens' "La Bamba" and War's "Cisco Kid." This event was captured in 2005.

programme.title: Chase Atlantic: Live from Hollywood
programme.desc: Chase Atlantic, an Australian trio based in LA, produce unique pop rock/R&B fusion. Their sound is identifiable through Mitchel Cave’s vocals and danceable tracks.

programme.title: Modest Mouse: Live From Red Rocks Amphitheatre
programme.desc: Modest Mouse performs live at Red Rocks Amphitheatre, showcasing songs from The Golden Casket in a special concert event.

programme.title: Lettuce with the Colorado Symphony
programme.desc: A genre-bending concert film where funk titans Lettuce join the Colorado Symphony for a thrilling night of symphonic groove. Guided by conductor Chris Dragon and orchestrations by Tom Hagerman, the set amplifies Lettuce’s deep-pocket improvisation with orchestral color—spotlighting searing solos, lush brass and strings, and reimagined moments from Mozart to Curtis Mayfield and Tears for Fears. Shot in Denver, the performance captures the band’s chemistry, the orchestra’s power, and the communal lift of “symphonic funk.”

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Producer/guitarist Josh Carter—one half of genre-bending duo Phantogram—joins host Joel Madden to talk about why trying too hard can kill the art, his creative/lifelong bond with bandmate Sarah Barthel, and gearing up for a summer tour with Deftones. From upstate New York origins to Brooklyn and now L.A., Josh digs into collaboration culture, beat-making roots, Big Grams with Big Boi, and the hip-hop influences (Beastie Boys, Wu-Tang, Public Enemy) that shaped his sound—plus a little baseball talk (Mets, Dodgers, Orioles).

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Chase Rice talks about his hit song, the challenges of festivals, and his experience at Stagecoach.

programme.title: Laufey’s: A Night at the Symphony - Hollywood Bowl
programme.desc: A cinematic concert film capturing Laufey’s spellbinding homecoming at the Hollywood Bowl, performed with the Los Angeles Philharmonic. Blending jazz-pop songwriting with lush orchestration, Laufey guides viewers through an evening of romance, nostalgia, and self-discovery—interwoven with behind-the-scenes moments, reflections on Los Angeles, and a special appearance from her twin sister, Junia.

programme.title: Flogging Molly: Live from Las Vegas
programme.desc: Flogging Molly performs a St. Patrick’s Day celebration live from Las Vegas with a high-energy set.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: The Chicks: Top of the World Tour Live
programme.desc: The Chicks, Grammy Award winners, launched their 2003 tour with Top Of The World Tour Live. Enjoy hits like 'Goodbye Earl,' 'A Home,' 'Landslide,' and more.

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.title: Wishbone Ash - Live In Hamburg
programme.desc: Ein legendärer Auftritt einer Hardrock-Legende in Hamburg! Diese Aufnahme vereint frisches Material mit zeitlosen Klassikern. Eine musikalische Reise durch mehr als dreißig Jahre Rockgeschichte, die pure Energie und Nostalgie verspricht.

programme.title: From The Scene For The Scene
programme.desc: Go beyond the music and into the heart of the underground. This collection pairs heavy-hitting videos with exclusive band interviews and reports from metal capitals worldwide. Built by the scene, for the scene.

programme.title: Black Metal Ceremony
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in darkness with this collection of raw, atmospheric black metal. From blistering tremolo riffs to unholy vocals, this playlist evokes ancient rituals and nocturnal desolation. Enter the abyss and join the ceremony.

programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths
programme.desc: Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

programme.title: Heavy Pumping
programme.desc: Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

programme.title: Power Metal Journey
programme.desc: Embark on a heroic quest fueled by soaring vocals, blistering guitar solos, and triumphant symphonic melodies. This playlist delivers high-energy anthems, epic fantasy tales, and pure, unstoppable speed metal glory.
